warnings: Table rows are 'ระดับอะเส' (tie-beam/eave level) and 'ระดับพื้นชั้น 1' / 'ตอม่อ' / 'ฐานราก' (floor-1 level / pedestal / footing). C0 prints a dash ('—') at 'ระดับอะเส' (no continuing column above floor level) while C1 prints an upward arrow (continues up) — matching this house's structure where only C1-marked positions carry a light steel column (CS, S-03) up to eave level. Recorded as a 'continues_above' flag rather than a separate rebar spec, since no additional rebar is printed for that continuation (it is the CS steel column, spec'd on S-03/S-08 area not this table).

The pedestal (ตอม่อ) box spec printed here (0.20x0.20m, 4-Ø12mm, Ø6mm@0.15m) is identical to what the seismic-zone versions of this same table print on S-10 and S-11 — the seismic provisions change the column's LONGITUDINAL bar spacing detail (a separate drawing below each table), not this pedestal cross-section spec itself.
